senses.gloss: ch. same, to cut into. Part. pass. חָרִיץ.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 20a:15">Gitt. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>רושמא מִיחֲרַץ ח׳ וכ׳</he> is the stamp of a coin dug into (are the devices formed with a loss of substance), or is it pressed into (by compressing the substance)?—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 41a:20">Bekh. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מיחרץ ח׳</he> (a dry scab is) cut into (deeper than the surface).
